name: Complete C4 Model
description: Generate all C4 levels (Context, Container, Component, Code) in D2
helpContent: Create comprehensive C4 model diagrams in D2 format showing system context, containers, components, and code-level details.
template:
Generate a complete C4 model in D2 with:
1. C1 Context: System and external actors
2. C2 Containers: Applications, databases, services
3. C3 Components: Internal structure
4. C4 Code: Class/method relationships (if applicable)

Each level should zoom in on the previous level.

name: Context + Container Levels
description: D2 diagram combining C1 and C2 levels
helpContent: Create a D2 diagram showing both system context and container levels in a single visualization.
template:
Create a D2 diagram showing:
1. System boundary and external actors
2. Internal containers (services, databases, apps)
3. Relationships between all elements

Use consistent notation for clarity.
